text: We’re obsessed with home energy dashboards as tools to slash carbon footprints, but we’re overlooking a massive blind spot: accessibility. Most interfaces rely on complex, color-coded graphs and dense data visualizations that are nearly impossible to navigate for people with visual impairments or cognitive disabilities. If we want a truly inclusive energy transition, our tools must move beyond flashy aesthetics. A dashboard that isn't accessible to everyone isn't just flawed—it actively excludes the very people who need to participate most.
